# First Verification Delta

## Planned
- Prompt and Mode should read as one continuous deck.
- Browser seam target: at most 1.1px.

## Actual
- Source, syntax, line-size, and deterministic gates passed.
- Deterministic suite: 43/43.
- Better V2 Chrome measured a 1.637451171875px Prompt/Mode seam and failed before later assertions.

## Delta
- `unified-deck.css` needed one additional pixel of overlap because browser subpixel geometry left a visible 1.64px seam with `margin-top:-1px`.

## Resolution
- Full-file rewrite changes Mode margin to `-2px`.
- Test threshold remains unchanged; the product must satisfy the proof.

NEXT_ACTION: rerun Better V2 browser smoke alone; if green, rerun the full regression graph.
